outcome: Neonatal hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 347 pregnant women at gestational age 37-40 weeks with appropriate-for-gestational-age fetuses
finding: Women with a CPR ≥ 0.67 multiples of the median had a significantly lower incidence of fetal distress, emergency cesarean section, neonatal hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit, and pH < 7.2 compared to women with a CPR < 0.67 multiples of the median.
